type_users:Cursor.docs: A named alias that resolves to an optional string, i.e. a pointer in Go.

type_users:RequiredCursor.docs: A named alias that resolves to a required string, i.e. a value in Go.

type_users:NullableCursor.docs: A named alias that resolves to a nullable string, which is also a pointer in Go.

endpoints.name: listWithBodyCursorPagination
endpoints.docs:
Pagination endpoint with an optional top-level cursor field in the request body. An empty
string cursor terminates the pager, just like a null cursor does.

endpoints.name: listWithRequiredBodyCursorPagination
endpoints.docs: Pagination endpoint with a required top-level cursor field in the request body.

endpoints.name: listWithUuidBodyCursorPagination
endpoints.docs:
Pagination endpoint with an optional uuid cursor field in the request body. Only string cursors
treat an empty value as the last page, so this endpoint terminates on a null cursor alone.

endpoints.name: listWithAliasBodyCursorPagination
endpoints.docs:
Pagination endpoint whose cursor is a named alias resolving to an optional string. The alias
generates as a pointer in Go, so an empty string cursor terminates the pager here too.

endpoints.name: listWithRequiredAliasBodyCursorPagination
endpoints.docs:
Pagination endpoint whose cursor is a named alias resolving to a required string. The alias
generates as a value in Go, where the zero value is already the empty string.

endpoints.name: listWithNullableAliasBodyCursorPagination
endpoints.docs:
Pagination endpoint whose cursor is a named alias resolving to a nullable string. Nullable
generates as a pointer in Go, so an empty string cursor terminates the pager here too.

endpoints.name: listWithBodyOffsetPagination
endpoints.docs: Pagination endpoint with a top-level page field in the request body.

endpoints.name: listWithNestedBodyCursorPagination
endpoints.docs:
Pagination endpoint with a nested cursor field in the request body. Nested page properties are
not supported, so this endpoint is generated without a pager.
